_meta.dataset: FOREXA Hybrid AI–NWP Blended Forecast Telemetry (Kerala 14 Districts)
_meta.status: Illustrative data — structured for live NOAA GFS (NWP), GraphCast (AI), and WeatherNext 2 (Ensemble) ingestion

wayanad.conditionSummary: Intense orographic cloudburst over Vythiri–Meppadi escarpment with saturated soil slopes.
wayanad.damRiskLevel: Critical · Banasura Sagar at 94% FRL (Red Alert Stage)
wayanad.confidenceReason: Strong Ensemble–AI convergence on 850 hPa westerly jet core hitting Western Ghats.
recommendedActions: Evacuate landslide-prone slopes in Meppadi, Chooralmala, and Vythiri taluks immediately.
Halt all night vehicular traffic along Thamarassery (NH-766) and Boys Town ghat roads.
Pre-position NDRF & KSDMA search-and-rescue teams and open 24x7 relief camps.

drivers.name: Orographic Lift along Western Ghats Escarpment
drivers.detail: Steep 950m terrain forcing rapid adiabatic cooling of moisture-laden Arabian Sea westerlies.

drivers.name: Offshore Monsoon Trough & Low-Level Jet (850 hPa)
drivers.detail: Sustained 45 kt cross-equatorial moisture flux convergence focused at 11.6°N.

drivers.name: Ensemble Member Cluster Convergence
drivers.detail: 44 of 50 WeatherNext 2 members exceed 200 mm/24h threshold over Wayanad plateau.

drivers.name: Recent 7-Day Rolling Skill Advantage (Ensemble + AI)
drivers.detail: Ensemble MAE (9.8 mm) outperformed coarse NWP (34.2 mm) during past 3 highland rain spikes.

kozhikode.conditionTitle: Cyclone ARB-04 · Coastal Squall & Extreme Rain
kozhikode.conditionSummary: Offshore cyclonic core tracking 45 km off Kozhikode coast with 88 km/h gale gusts and storm surge.
kozhikode.damRiskLevel: High · Kakkayam Reservoir spillway regulation on standby
kozhikode.confidenceReason: GraphCast AI vortex tracker and Ensemble storm-surge members tightly aligned on Malabar track.
recommendedActions: Complete total ban on deep-sea and coastal fishing from Beypore, Puthiyappa, and Koyilandy harbours.
Evacuate coastal wards within 250m of high-tide line due to 2.8m storm surge forecast.
Secure KSEB high-tension feeders and deploy emergency mobile comms units in Kuttiady foothills.

drivers.name: Arabian Sea Cyclonic Vortex ARB-04
drivers.detail: 992 hPa deep depression intensifying offshore with tight outer rainband feeder bands.

drivers.name: Coastal Convergence & Friction Gale Acceleration
drivers.detail: Onshore 88 km/h gusts piling up 2.4–2.8m astronomical + barometric surge.

drivers.name: GraphCast AI Track Skill Dominance
drivers.detail: AI mesoscale vortex track error <14 km over last 4 forecast initializations.

drivers.name: Eastern Foothill Orographic Feeder Band
drivers.detail: Secondary cloudburst potential over Thamarassery and Koorachundu ranges.

idukki.conditionTitle: Extremely heavy rainfall · Dam inflow & Landslide
idukki.conditionSummary: Persistent high-intensity rain over Periyar catchment and Munnar–Devikulam steep slopes.
idukki.damRiskLevel: Critical · Idukki Reservoir at 2398.4 ft (Orange-to-Red Rule Curve)
idukki.confidenceReason: High terrain locking of convective bands verified across 90% of ensemble members.
recommendedActions: Issue Cheruthoni Dam downstream bank evacuation alert along Periyar river corridor.
Suspend all tourist movement and heavy transport to Munnar, Rajamala, and Peerumedu.
Monitor soil moisture sensors in Devikulam and Udumbanchola taluks continuously.

drivers.name: Southern Western Ghats Orographic Barrier (1250m+)
drivers.detail: Continuous uplift of deep tropospheric moisture column over Anamudi-Munnar ridge.

drivers.name: Periyar Catchment Inflow Acceleration
drivers.detail: Runoff coefficient exceeding 0.82 due to multi-day antecedent soil saturation.

drivers.name: Ensemble Extreme Quantile Shift (95th Percentile)
drivers.detail: WeatherNext 2 tail members indicate localized 240+ mm/24h pockets.

malappuram.conditionTitle: Very heavy rainfall · Chaliyar flash flood risk
malappuram.conditionSummary: Heavy runoff from Nilambur upper catchment feeding rapid rise in Chaliyar & Kadalundi rivers.
malappuram.damRiskLevel: Elevated · Chaliyar river gauge approaching warning level at Nilambur
malappuram.confidenceReason: Strong agreement between GraphCast and WeatherNext 2 on Nilambur basin accumulation.
recommendedActions: Alert riverine panchayats along Chaliyar and Kadalundi basins for potential bank overflow.
Monitor Kavalappara and Pothukallu hill slopes for early soil creep signs.
Keep emergency boats and civil defense teams ready in Tirur and Ponnani coastal zones.

drivers.name: Nilambur Valley Funneling Effect
drivers.detail: Chaliyar amphitheater terrain concentrating moisture flux into upper tributaries.

drivers.name: Downstream River Stage Accumulation
drivers.detail: Combined Wayanad-Camel's Hump runoff draining through Nilambur plains.

kannur.conditionTitle: Cyclone outer band · Very heavy rain & Gales
kannur.conditionSummary: Northern feeder band of ARB-04 sweeping Kannur coast and Iritty–Brahmagiri hills.
kannur.damRiskLevel: Watch · Pazhassi Barrage shutters opened for regulated discharge
kannur.confidenceReason: Consistent coastal wind-field and rainband timing between AI and NWP models.
recommendedActions: Enforce coastal warning for Azhikode and Thalassery fishing harbours.
Monitor Iritty and Aralam hill ranges for localized flash floods.
Prune hazardous trees near hospital and highway corridors.

drivers.name: Cyclone ARB-04 Northern Feeder Arm
drivers.detail: Strong onshore southeasterly-to-westerly shear line crossing 12.0°N.

drivers.name: Brahmagiri Foothill Convergence
drivers.detail: Enhanced convective cells anchoring over eastern Kannur taluks.

ernakulam.conditionTitle: Very heavy rainfall · Urban & Periyar flood risk
ernakulam.conditionSummary: Intense coastal squalls combined with high tide and Periyar basin discharge.
ernakulam.damRiskLevel: High · Bhoothathankettu Barrage all shutters raised; Aluva gauge monitored
ernakulam.confidenceReason: Low ensemble spread across central coastal plains.
recommendedActions: Activate high-capacity dewatering pumps across Kochi city low-lying zones (M.G. Road, Kaloor).
Put Aluva, Paravur, and Kothamangalam riverine wards on flood watch.
Coordinate Cochin Port & Naval Base tidal lock management.

drivers.name: Periyar River Discharge + Spring Tide Coincidence
drivers.detail: Backwater hydraulic locking restricting rapid urban drainage into Vembanad estuary.

drivers.name: Central Coastal Squall Line Passage
drivers.detail: 18–24 mm/h convective bursts riding onshore westerlies.

thrissur.conditionTitle: Very heavy rainfall · Chalakudy basin watch
thrissur.conditionSummary: Sustained heavy downpours over Athirappilly–Peringalkuthu forest catchment.
thrissur.damRiskLevel: High · Peringalkuthu Dam at 91% storage; controlled sluice release active
thrissur.confidenceReason: Tight NWP and Ensemble consensus on central Kerala rain belt.
recommendedActions: Maintain orange alert along Chalakudy river banks and low-lying causeways.
Restrict tourist entry to Athirappilly and Vazhachal waterfalls.
Monitor Peechi and Chimmini dam inflows every 3 hours.

drivers.name: Chalakudy Upper Catchment Orographic Plume
drivers.detail: Continuous moisture transport into Sholayar-Peringalkuthu cascade.

drivers.name: Midland Convective Training
drivers.detail: Back-building rain cells producing 140+ mm/24h totals.

pathanamthitta.conditionTitle: Very heavy rainfall · Pamba basin & Ghat watch
pathanamthitta.conditionSummary: Heavy forest catchment rain over Goodrickal, Kakki, and Sabarimala hills.
pathanamthitta.damRiskLevel: Elevated · Kakki-Anathode at 86% storage; Pamba Triveni gauge rising
pathanamthitta.confidenceReason: Moderate spread in southern ghat convective cell placement between NWP and AI.
recommendedActions: Monitor Pamba, Achenkovil, and Manimala river levels at Ranni and Thiruvalla.
Advise caution along Konni–Achankovil and Moozhiyar forest roads.

drivers.name: Eastern Forested Ghat Moisture Trapping
drivers.detail: Orographic enhancement over Ranni and Konni reserve forests.

drivers.name: Pamba Headwater Runoff Surge
drivers.detail: Steep basin slope yielding rapid 6-hour hydrograph peak.

kottayam.conditionTitle: Heavy rainfall · Meenachil & Eastern hill watch
kottayam.conditionSummary: Thundershowers over Mundakayam–Erattupetta hills and Kuttanad eastern fringe.
kottayam.damRiskLevel: Moderate · Meenachil river at Pala within safe bank capacity
kottayam.confidenceReason: Balanced multi-model consensus across midland stations.
recommendedActions: Monitor Koottickal, Poonjar, and Mundakayam hill panchayats during evening peak rain.
Keep Vaikom and Kumarakom backwater bund pumping stations ready.

drivers.name: Midland-to-Foothill Convective Trigger
drivers.detail: Afternoon thermal instability interacting with monsoon westerlies.

drivers.name: Vembanad Backwater Drainage Lag
drivers.detail: Slow outflow in western taluks during high tide.

alappuzha.conditionTitle: Heavy rainfall · Kuttanad waterlogging & Swell waves
alappuzha.conditionSummary: High sea swell waves (Kallakkadal) along coast and rising water levels in Kuttanad polders.
alappuzha.damRiskLevel: Watch · Thottappally Spillway 32 shutters open to drain Pamba floodwater
alappuzha.confidenceReason: High skill in coastal NWP + AI wave-rainfall coupling.
recommendedActions: Keep Thottappally Spillway Approach Channel clear for maximum Pamba discharge.
Alert fishermen and coastal residents in Ambalappuzha and Cherthala regarding 2.2m swell waves.

drivers.name: Upstream Pamba-Manimala Inflow into Kuttanad
drivers.detail: Below-sea-level polders receiving combined eastern midland drainage.

drivers.name: Arabian Sea Long-Period Swell Surge
drivers.detail: 2.0–2.4m wave run-up along Alappuzha–Purakkad coast.

palakkad.conditionTitle: Heavy rainfall · Palakkad Gap gusty winds
palakkad.conditionSummary: Channeled 55 km/h winds through Palakkad Gap with heavy rain over Silent Valley & Nelliyampathy.
palakkad.damRiskLevel: Moderate · Malampuzha & Mangalam dams at 78% capacity; normal regulation
palakkad.confidenceReason: Strong physical representation of Palakkad Gap wind jet in NWP and AI.
recommendedActions: Exercise caution on Nelliyampathy and Attappadi hairpin roads.
Monitor Bharathapuzha tributaries for moderate level rise.

drivers.name: Palakkad Gap Venturi Wind Acceleration
drivers.detail: 30 km discontinuity in Western Ghats accelerating low-level monsoon flow.

drivers.name: Silent Valley Escarpment Uplift
drivers.detail: Localized heavy showers on northern Mannarkkad hills.

kasaragod.conditionSummary: Intermittent heavy monsoon squalls and gusty onshore winds across Chandragiri basin.
kasaragod.damRiskLevel: Normal · Chandragiri and Tejaswini rivers flowing below warning mark
kasaragod.confidenceReason: Steady synoptic monsoon regime across northern Malabar.
recommendedActions: Small mechanized fishing vessels advised not to venture far offshore.
Monitor low-lying river crossings in Nileshwaram and Uppala.

drivers.name: Northern Malabar Onshore Moisture Flux
drivers.detail: Peripheral rainbands moving northeastward at 18 kt.

drivers.name: Laterite Plateau Runoff
drivers.detail: Fast surface drainage into coastal estuaries.

kollam.conditionSummary: Passing light-to-moderate showers over Ashtamudi coast and Thenmala hills.
kollam.damRiskLevel: Safe · Thenmala (Parappar) Dam at 68% capacity; no spillway release required
kollam.confidenceReason: All three models confirm main convective core stays north of 9.2°N.
recommendedActions: Standard monsoon monitoring; no emergency restrictions required.
Routine coastal patrol along Neendakara harbour.

drivers.name: Southern Weakened Monsoon Gradient
drivers.detail: Core low-level jet displaced northward toward Central/North Kerala.

thiruvananthapuram.conditionTitle: Light to moderate showers · Normal conditions
thiruvananthapuram.conditionSummary: Brief passing showers over Agasthyamala hills; calm urban conditions in capital.
thiruvananthapuram.damRiskLevel: Safe · Neyyar, Peppara & Aruvikkara dams within normal operating levels
thiruvananthapuram.confidenceReason: High model skill and low variance (<1.2 mm/h) across all 3 engines.
recommendedActions: Normal operations across Thiruvananthapuram district.
Standard coastal vigil for Vizhinjam and Shankumugham beaches.

drivers.name: Stable Southern Ridge Pressure Gradient
drivers.detail: Weak synoptic forcing south of 8.8°N latitude.
